summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of Word Chainz Deluxe iteration 2. All previously reported bugs (localStorage sync, browser back button) are FIXED and working correctly. Tested 8 game modes, navigation, settings, and shop. Found 1 critical UI bug with shop modal overlay.

ui_bugs.issue: Bottom navigation bar intercepts clicks on 'Buy now' button in purchase confirmation modal
ui_bugs.details: When attempting to purchase items in the Gift Shop, the confirmation modal appears but the 'Buy now' button cannot be clicked because the bottom navigation bar (z-index issue) intercepts pointer events. Modal should have higher z-index or bottom nav should be hidden when modal is open. Error: 'subtree intercepts pointer events' from bottom-nav element.
